item.tib: bder gshegs dgongs pa kun 'dus thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu'i yang snying las rtsa gsum kun 'dus las rim chung ba bla med snying po
item.coloph: bka' gter ma bu kha sbyor 'di ltar yod tshul zur tsam gleng pa'i sgros la/ nges slob kyi thu bo dam pa skyes mchog stag sprul dmu wer shel zhin gyi rten 'brel 'phrod rkyen gyi brda sbyar ba la brten nas/ kho bo g.yung drung bdud 'dul thog med rtsal gyis rigs bzhi'i nang tshan rin chen rigs kyi gnas mchog bam brag brtsegs pa/ rin chen 'bar ba'i mthil/ mtsho steng bde ldan khrod kyi yang dben du lcags rta dbo zla'i gral tshes dge bar gtan la phabs te (phab ste)/ dang po'i yi ge'i byed po 'phrin las lhun grub can des mtho phyogs spyi bor blangs te/ bskrun pa'i dge tshogs bstan 'gror smin pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
